note: Benchmark manifest for Khayoota AI model selection. Every pattern text below was written for this benchmark (no third-party pattern is reproduced). Image fixtures are NOT committed: a team member renders / handwrites / photographs the `sourceText` (or the described object) and saves it under fixtures/ with the listed file name. See ../benchmark-plan.md.

sharedTexts.ballAr:
كرة صغيرة
الدور ١: ٦ غرز قصيرة في MR (٦)
الدور ٢: زيادة × ٦ (١٢)
الدور ٣: (غرزة قصيرة، زيادة) × ٦ (١٨)
الدور ٤: (٢ غرزة قصيرة، زيادة) × ٦ (٢٤)
الدور ٥ - ٧: ٢٤ غرزة قصيرة (٢٤)
الدور ٨: (٢ غرزة قصيرة، نقص) × ٦ (١٨)
الدور ٩: (غرزة قصيرة، نقص) × ٦ (١٢)
الدور ١٠: نقص × ٦ (٦)
احشي الكرة قبل الدور ٩ ثم اقفلي واقطعي الخيط.
sharedTexts.ballUs:
Small ball
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc x 6 (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x 6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) x 6 (24)
Rnd 5-7: 24 sc (24)
Rnd 8: (2 sc, dec) x 6 (18)
Rnd 9: (sc, dec) x 6 (12)
Rnd 10: dec x 6 (6)
Stuff before round 9. Fasten off and weave in the end.
sharedTexts.ballUk:
Small ball (UK terms)
Rnd 1: 6 dc in magic ring (6)
Rnd 2: 2 dc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: (1 dc, 2 dc in next st) x 6 (18)
Rnd 4: 18 htr (18)
Rnd 5: (1 dc, dc2tog) x 6 (12)
Rnd 6: dc2tog x 6 (6)
sharedTexts.bearParts:
دبدوب صغير
الراس:
R1: 6sc in MR [6]
R2: inc x 6 [12]
R3: (sc, inc) x 6 [18]
R4-R6: 18sc [18]
R7: (sc, dec) x 6 [12]
الجسم:
R1: 6sc in MR [6]
R2: inc x 6 [12]
R3-R6: 12sc [12]
الايد (2):
R1: 6sc in MR [6]
R2-R5: 6sc [6]
الودن × 2:
R1: 5sc in MR [5]
خيطي الودان على الراس بين الدور 3 و 5.
sharedTexts.bunnyDress:
Bunny dress (reference summary — NOT a verified transcription of the source video)
Start: ch 43
Row 1: 42 sc
Row 2: armhole chains, skips and increases — 54 positions in total
Row 3: 60 sc
Rows 4-8: 60 sc
Round 9: 120 dc
Round 10: 180 dc
Rounds 11-14: 180 dc

cases.prompt: الصورة دي فيها باترون، ممكن تقريه وتجهزيه؟

cases.sourceText:
قبعة
الدور الأول: ١٠ عمود في MR (١٠)
الدور الثاني: زيادة عمود × ١٠ (٢٠)
الدور الثالث: (عمود، زيادة عمود) × ١٠ (٣٠)
الدور الرابع: ٣٠ نص عمود (٣٠)

قاعدة سلة
الدور ١: ٨ حشو في MR (٨)
الدور ٢: زيادة × ٨ (١٦)

expect.mustFlag: the word حشو is ambiguous (stuffing vs single crochet) — Needs Review, as the deterministic parser does

cases.handwriting: neat ruq'ah, blue pen, lined paper
cases.prompt: ده باترون مكتوب بخط إيدي، اقريه.

cases.handwriting: fast handwriting, pencil, one crossed-out line (R4-R6 of the head rewritten)

expect.mustFlag: the crossed-out line is reported as uncertain, not silently merged

cases.handwriting: rounds 5-7 smudged so the total is unreadable

expect.mustFlag: rounds 5-7 total unreadable → Needs Review; total must NOT be invented from neighbouring rounds without saying so

cases.prompt: Read this pattern and prepare it for the app.

cases.sourceText:
Leaf
Row 1: ch 9
Row 2: sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc, 2 dc, 2 tr, hdc, sc (8)
Fasten off.

expect.mustFlag: chains and 'in 2nd ch from hook' are outside the tracker's supported notation → those rows are Unsupported and kept verbatim

cases.prompt: What is the difference between sc2tog and an invisible decrease, and which should I use for amigurumi?

facts: both turn 2 stitches into 1
invisible decrease works through front loops only and leaves a smaller bump
invisible decrease is usually preferred for amigurumi

expect.mustFlag: UK terms detected (htr present) and converted: UK dc = US sc, UK htr = US hdc

cases.prompt: My pattern is British and says 'tr'. What stitch is that in American terms?

facts: UK treble (tr) = US double crochet (dc)
expect.mustNot: answer 'US treble'

cases.sourceText:
الجسم
R1: 6sc في MR (6)
R2: inc × 6 (12)
الدور 3: (sc, زيادة) × 6 (18)
R4-R5: 18 sc (18)

cases.prompt: يعني إيه (2sc, inc) x 6 وهيطلع كام غرزة؟

facts: repeat the group 6 times
each repeat uses 3 stitches and produces 4
total 24 stitches, from 18
expect.style: Egyptian Arabic; abbreviations sc / inc kept in Latin letters

cases.prompt: الباترون مكتوب فيه hdc، دي إيه بالعربي وبتتعمل إزاي؟

facts: half double crochet / نص عمود
yarn over, insert, pull up a loop, yarn over, pull through all three loops

cases.degradation: screenshot re-saved at JPEG quality 20, 480 px wide

expect.mustFlag: any digit that cannot be read reliably is marked uncertain

cases.degradation: chat-app screenshot with UI chrome, timestamp and an emoji overlapping round 6

expect.mustNot: treat chat UI text (names, timestamps) as pattern content

expect.mustFlag: says which rounds could not be read and asks for a clearer photo; partial result only
expect.mustNot: produce 10 confident rounds

cases.degradation: photographed at a steep angle with glare over rounds 3-4

cases.sourceText: Two-column page. Left column: Head (R1: 6sc in MR [6]; R2: inc x 6 [12]; R3: (sc, inc) x 6 [18]). Right column: Body (R1: 6sc in MR [6]; R2: inc x 6 [12]; R3-R5: 12sc [12]).
cases.prompt: Extract every part from this page.

expect.mustNot: interleave rounds from the two columns

cases.layout: two photographed pages; page 2 starts in the middle of the body

expect.mustKeep: page order; evidence references name the page

cases.sourceText: Round symbol chart of a flat coaster drawn by the team from: R1: 12 dc in MR [12]; R2: dc-inc x 12 [24]; R3: (dc, dc-inc) x 12 [36]. Standard symbols with a legend.
cases.prompt: Can you read this stitch chart?

cases.sourceText: Symbol legend only: chain (oval), slip stitch (dot), sc (x / +), hdc (T), dc (T with one bar), tr (T with two bars).

facts: names each symbol correctly in Arabic with the Latin abbreviation
expect.mustNot: invent symbols that are not in the image

cases.sourceText: Photo of a printed chart with NO legend and partly cropped outer round.
cases.prompt: Turn this chart into written rounds.

expect.mustFlag: outer round cropped → cannot be extracted; no legend → symbol meanings assumed and stated
expect.mustNot: report a complete validated pattern

cases.sourceText:
Assembly
1. Stuff the head firmly and the body lightly.
2. Sew the head to the body.
3. Attach the ears between rounds 3 and 5 of the head, 6 stitches apart.
4. Sew the arms to the sides of the body at round 4.
5. Embroider the nose with black yarn.

expect.mustNot: turn assembly steps into rounds or stitch counts

cases.prompt: أركب الإيدين على الجسم إزاي علشان يبقوا متساويين؟

facts: pin both pieces first
use the same round and count stitches from the centre on each side
whip stitch / mattress stitch through both loops
check symmetry before fastening off

cases.object: two finished amigurumi arms side by side; the second was worked with one accidental increase round so it is visibly wider (12 instead of 9 stitches)
cases.prompt: الإيد دي مختلفة عن الأولى، أعمل إيه؟

expect.mustSay: cannot confirm the exact stitch count from the photo
expect.nextStep: count the stitches of the last round against the expected 9

cases.object: amigurumi tube worked in a continuous spiral showing the normal diagonal lean of the round start
cases.prompt: Why is my seam slanting? Did I do something wrong?

expect.mustSay: this lean is normal for continuous spiral rounds
expect.mustNot: diagnose a stitch-count error

cases.object: stuffed ball with stuffing visible through gaps between stitches

hypotheses: hook too large for the yarn

cases.object: flat circle that ruffles at the edge
cases.prompt: My circle is wavy. What happened?

expect.mustSay: cannot count the increases reliably from the photo

cases.prompt: My pattern says: R4: (2sc, inc) x 6 [26]. Is that right?

facts: (2sc, inc) x 6 produces 24, not 26
it uses 18 stitches from the previous round
expect.mustNot: accept 26

cases.prompt: الدور اللي فات كان 18 غرزة، والدور ده مكتوب (3sc, inc) x 6. ينفع؟

facts: this round needs 24 stitches but the previous round has 18
the usual next step after 18 is (2sc, inc) x 6 = 24
expect.mustFlag: does not rewrite the pattern silently — suggests checking the source
